about_the_game:
Boundless AI Fantasy is an innovative indie RPG that combines AI-driven roleplaying with a tactical turn-based combat. Players design their own worlds, campaigns, characters, and stories, then watch as language models narrate, inhabit, and evolve those creations in real time, delivering a truly personalized, dynamic adventure. When conflict arises, dive into tactical turn-based combat with a grid-based system.

Quality is my goal!

• Multi-Agent System: Every NPC is powered by its own “agent” with unique memories, goals, and motivations. Agents interact autonomously with each other and with the player, and can think before acting, while the main narration model summarizes outcomes and drives the overarching plot. Other hidden models are also used to decide game mechanics.

• By crafting your own world, you not only unleash your creativity but also enhance the AI's performance, giving context to the model and ensuring less generic and more engaging narratives.

Turn-Based Tactical Combat!

• Isometric, Grid-Based Battles: When combat starts, the view shifts to an isometric battlefield. Position your party on a tactical grid, coordinate movement, exploit range, and deploy spells.

World & Campaign Creation!

• Fully Customizable Campaigns, Character & Spell: Design entire worlds from scratch, define maps, lore, and major plot arcs, craft protagonists, companions, and enemies with bespoke appearances, stats, background, and skills. Every attribute you set influences AI decision-making in both roleplay and combat.

AI Models are run locally on your machine via Ollama, so you must install Ollama.

This game is a personal project done fully by a single developer. You can contact me on discord and share your opinions, ideas, or criticisms. Every feedback I receive is important.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any GPU supported by Ollama with enough VRAM to run AI text models, 6GB is enough for smaller models
  • Additional Notes: Available storage space for the AI models is needed

short_description: Roleplay with AI-driven characters, command turn‑based tactical battles on an isometric grid, create expansive campaigns, customize worlds, characters, and spells, and experience dynamic narratives shaped by your choices.
